chunks: Whatever is in Hā from Manṣūr ibn Yūnus, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥadīd and Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ together, from Manṣūr ibn Yūnus Buzurj.

key_terms.بُزُرْجَ: Buzurj; an identifying epithet for Manṣūr ibn Yūnus
key_terms.جَمِيعًا: together; indicates both named transmitters narrate jointly from the next narrator
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s direct statement of transmission
key_terms.عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ يُونُسَ: from Manṣūr ibn Yūnus; the focal transmitter whose route is being clarified

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Manṣūr ibn Yūnus in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage is a sanad clarification identifying the transmission route for reports narrated from Manṣūr ibn Yūnus in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving hadith provenance within Shia hadith scholarship.
